## About
The Dent Repair Shop is a locally owned, full-time paintless dent repair shop on S Congress Ave in Austin. The shop is easy to get to and simple to find.
Paintless dent repair means we work the metal back into shape without paint or filler, so your car keeps its factory finish. We handle everything from small door dings to a whole car's worth of hail damage, on a range of makes and models.
We're accredited by the Better Business Bureau, and we work with rental car companies and body shops around town. Call, stop by, or send a photo of the damage for a free quote.

## Services
- Door dings: Those small, quarter-sized or smaller dents from parking lots and car doors. These are usually quick fixes.
- Medium-sized dents: Dents from about golf ball to business card size, taken out with care and precision.
- Large dents: Bigger dents need specialized tools and techniques, and more time in the shop.
- Body line dents: Dents that cross a body line take careful, precise work to get the shape right again.
- Hail damage repair: Every hail job is different, so we look at each car individually to give an accurate estimate of time and cost.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Fill out the quote form with a description of the damage and add a photo if you can. A picture helps us get you a no-obligation quote faster.

Q: Can I just stop by?
A: Yes. Give us a call or drop by the shop on S Congress Ave for a quote.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open weekdays and closed on weekends. Extended hours are available by appointment.

Q: Do you work with customers outside Austin?
A: Yes. We serve Austin along with Leander, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Pflugerville and Buda.
